scope: Independent hand derivation before candidate execution; declared QUIC packet sizes, no actual transport performance
assumptions: At t=5 key-installation arrival is processed before choosing any next data packet; an already serialized packet is not retroactively relabeled.
Control ACK and Finished have priority over unsent application tail; this is an explicit scheduling choice, not universal QUIC behavior.

Rejected early offset ranges are not accepted; with application authorization retransmit the sent prefix followed by unsent tail in original stream order. Without authorization neither rejected prefix nor remaining request is sent as a new request.
All packets have exactly one second serialization; ACK and Finished use declared padding to1200 UDP bytes. Effective payload and physical bytes remain different quantities.
